text: Demagogues and delegates meet for summit talks, The God-deniers, the Messiah-defiers:
At first he's amused at their presumption;
Is spread for him on the holy summit."
He said, "You're my son, And today is your birthday.
Nations as a present? continents as a prize?
Or throw them out with tomorrow's trash."
Your very lives are in danger, you know; His anger is about to explode, But if you make a run for God—you won't regret it!
